items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private and preview-only. Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, historical derivatives, cached display, alerts, images, prices, or affiliate/advertising use. Current public terms point against the proposed use. Human counsel is required before any rights outreach, jurisdictional privacy decision, affiliate use, or public exposure.

Compliance baseline is mixed: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 checked sites. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only on sites with evidenced consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Do not add tracking, monetization, cross-site data use, or unsupported claims where compliance status is failed or unknown.

Keep complicated.work parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. The existing readiness packet must record dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance and security unknowns, analytics/affiliate boundaries, rollback evidence, and the explicit launch decision before any build, deploy, DNS, monetization, or queue admission.
